provider: OpenAI image generation via built-in Codex imagegen

idle.action: Hungry empty-bowl offering with breathing and a full blink.

running-right.action: Ahoge suspension, gentle body sway, dangling legs and bilateral tail wag.

running-left.method: Per-cell mirror, original temporal order; native-resolution approved strip.

jumping.action: Standing bilateral tail wag while holding the same cream bowl.

running.action: Compact eating cycle, head/hair/fin silhouette matched to hungry idle.

original_workflow: Pets plugin 0.1.6 bundled extraction, inspection, composition, despill and quality gates. Plugin/client code is not redistributed.
reproduction_boundary: frames.zip rebuilds exact RGBA pixels. High-resolution sources and prompts support editing; AI reruns and source extraction are not guaranteed byte-identical.
source_resolution_note: All newly drawn strips retain their original tool output. running-left is a native per-cell derivation; its high-resolution origin is running-right.
